title: Clementine mission as photo reconnaissance for moon bases
summary: Maaneli Derakhshani tells of Clementine mission as photo reconnaissance for moon bases, about 1994 at The Moon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Brandenburgg says that the Clementine mission was basically a photo reconnaissance mission to see if someone was building bases on the moon that we didn't know about and were they expanding them.

plain: Maaneli Derakhshani, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on a claim from John Brandenburg, made in a book called Aliens on the Moon: The Truth Exposed. Brandenburg says that Clementine, a 1994 space mission to the Moon, was really a photo-spying mission to check whether someone was building bases on the Moon that we didn't know about, and whether those bases were growing. If true, it would mean officials suspected someone else was active on the Moon.
